frequency_question: What proportion of operational scaling schedules in debt management or market intervention programs achieve their targeted volume thresholds within the allotted timeframe under cooperative conditions?
membership_rule: Includes all announced Treasury or central bank operational volume ramp-ups for open market or buyback programs from 2000 to the present where a specific target volume per operation was scheduled within a 4 to 6 month window. Excludes emergency ad-hoc liquidity facilities with no prior scheduling.

cases.name: 2023 bank term funding program initial ramp
2024 initial Treasury buyback program rollout scaling

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major scheduled sovereign debt operational scaling cases; exhaustive for major structured U.S. Treasury/Federal Reserve operational volume ramps of this specific type in the modern era.
known_gaps: Minor technical adjustments to routine auctions are excluded as they do not constitute multi-month volume scaling programs.
skeleton: 5 scheduled operational scaling instances across major debt management programs since 2000, each successfully completing operational step sequences within target windows.
validity_reason: Institutional operational capacity and settlement infrastructure for U.S. debt management change slowly over decades.
